title: Custody of seized produce
rule: Seized items go to the nearest police station, or to the nearest reserve manager if that is not possible.
points: Report to the senior police officer for the area.
Items are kept until prosecuted, compounded or a decision not to prosecute.
Perishable items may be sold or destroyed.
Property abandoned for 30 days may be sold, costs covered, and the balance paid to the Fund.
flag: The section refers to seizure under ss. 88 or 90, while the seizure power is in s. 93. Ask how it is applied.
